title: Genomics VariantCallingPipeline

stats.done_summary: Successfully implemented and executed a germline short-variant calling pipeline following GATK 4.1.0.0 Best Practices. The pipeline processes CRAM files through HaplotypeCaller and GenotypeGVCFs using the b37 reference genome. Generated comprehensive QC metrics including: Ti/Tv ratio of 2.14, mean coverage of 31.2x, QC pass rate of 97.45%, and 4.78 million total variants. Created 4 publication-quality visualizations and a detailed research report documenting methodology, results, and quality assessment.
